operation.description:
Create or update an environment with protection rules, such as required reviewers. For more information about environment protection rules, see "[Environments](/actions/reference/environments#environment-protection-rules)."

> [!NOTE]
> To create or update name patterns that branches must match in order to deploy to this environment, see "[Deployment branch policies](/rest/deployments/branch-policies)."

> [!NOTE]
> To create or update secrets for an environment, see "[GitHub Actions secrets](/rest/actions/secrets)."

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

reviewers.description: The people or teams that may review jobs that reference the environment. You can list up to six users or teams as reviewers. The reviewers must have at least read access to the repository. Only one of the required reviewers needs to approve the job for it to proceed.

id.description: The id of the user or team who can review the deployment

422.description: Validation error when the environment name is invalid or when `protected_branches` and `custom_branch_policies` in `deployment_branch_policy` are set to the same value

#/components/parameters/environment-name.description: The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.
#/components/parameters/environment-name.name: environment_name

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.description: The type of deployment branch policy for this environment. To allow all branches to deploy, set to `null`.

custom_branch_policies.description: Whether only branches that match the specified name patterns can deploy to this environment.  If `custom_branch_policies` is `true`, `protected_branches` must be `false`; if `custom_branch_policies` is `false`, `protected_branches` must be `true`.

protected_branches.description: Whether only branches with branch protection rules can deploy to this environment. If `protected_branches` is `true`, `custom_branch_policies` must be `false`; if `protected_branches` is `false`, `custom_branch_policies` must be `true`.

created_at.description: The time that the environment was created, in ISO 8601 format.

protection_rules.description: Built-in deployment protection rules for the environment.

prevent_self_review.description: Whether deployments to this environment can be approved by the user who created the deployment.

reviewers.description: The people or teams that may approve jobs that reference the environment. You can list up to six users or teams as reviewers. The reviewers must have at least read access to the repository. Only one of the required reviewers needs to approve the job for it to proceed.

updated_at.description: The time that the environment was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

#/components/schemas/nullable-team-simpl.description: Groups of organization members that gives permissions on specified repositories.

enterprise_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise to which this team belongs

ldap_dn.description: Distinguished Name (DN) that team maps to within LDAP environment

notification_setting.description: The notification setting the team has set

organization_id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which this team belongs

permission.description: Permission that the team will have for its repositories

privacy.description: The level of privacy this team should have

type.description: The ownership type of the team

#/components/schemas/nullable-team-simpl.title: Team Simple

#/components/schemas/prevent-self-review.description: Whether or not a user who created the job is prevented from approving their own job.

#/components/schemas/team.description: Groups of organization members that gives permissions on specified repositories.

access_source.description:
How the team's access to the repository was granted. This property is only
present when the team is returned in a repository context, such as
`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams`.

enterprise_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise to which this team belongs

organization_id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which this team belongs

type.description: The ownership type of the team

#/components/schemas/team.title: Team

#/components/schemas/wait-timer.description: The amount of time to delay a job after the job is initially triggered. The time (in minutes) must be an integer between 0 and 43,200 (30 days).
